problem: Many small brands lacked a clear identity and scale.
title: Costco consolidates its private labels under the Kirkland Signature brand
context: Price/Costco had two dozen to 30 private brands, and private label was about 7 to 8 percent of sales in 1995.
decision_made: Consolidate them under one name, Kirkland Signature.
action_taken: Launched the brand in 1995 with products such as shampoo and vitamins.
observed_outcome: Recent reports put Kirkland at about a quarter to a third of Costco's revenue, with figures from $56 billion to $86 billion depending on the source and year.
lessons: A single, trusted private label can become a large share of sales and a reason to shop.
limitations: Share figures vary by year, revenue base and whether gasoline is included. Costco's 10-K was not checked.

claims.claim_text: Costco consolidated its private labels under the Kirkland Signature name in 1995.
Fortune reported Kirkland items generated $56 billion, or 23 percent of Costco's business, in a recent fiscal year.
